at-0007.title: Money operations accept keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`. Check it first via ledgerly.audit.events() before any state validation, return the original record on a repeat, and include idempotency_key in the audit.record() entry (INC-204).
